faqs.question: How much does car rental in Agadir cost?
faqs.answer: Economy cars often start around €28–€45 per day for 5+ days outside peak weeks. SUVs cost more. We send a clear daily total on WhatsApp before you book.

faqs.question: Do you deliver to hotels and riads in Agadir?
faqs.answer: Yes. Free delivery covers most Agadir city and beach hotels plus many riads. Share the property name or a map pin when you message us.

faqs.question: Is airport pickup included on this page?
faqs.answer: This page is for city and hotel delivery. For Agadir Al Massira (AGA) meet & greet, use our airport rental page so timing follows your flight.

faqs.question: What is the minimum rental length?
faqs.answer: We usually work with a 5-day minimum. Ask on WhatsApp if your dates are shorter - availability depends on the season and model.

faqs.question: Which car for Paradise Valley or Imsouane?
faqs.answer: An SUV or higher-clearance crossover is more comfortable for Paradise Valley and some coastal roads. City cars are fine for Agadir Beach and downtown.

faqs.question: What documents do I need?
faqs.answer: A valid driving licence plus passport or national ID. We confirm anything extra (second driver, young driver) during WhatsApp confirmation.

faqs.question: Can I get a long-stay discount?
faqs.answer: Week-plus and month-style hires often get a better daily rate. Tell us the full length when you enquire.

faqs.question: How fast do you reply on WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Most booking messages get a same-day reply with options. Include dates, hotel, and preferred car class to speed things up.
